name: right-behavior
label: RIGHT-BEHAVIOR
title: Right behavior: only what the state allows, and a reason when not
summary: The agent is offered only the acts the current state allows, sends each one with the validator from the state it read, and gets a reason when an act is absent. At the small scale it is a Gherkin scenario that says what right means before any code is written.
